Policies & FAQ

Booking & Deposits

A deposit is required to secure your booking. The amount varies depending on the type and length of the session. If a deposit is not received within 72 hours, the booking may be cancelled and the time slot made available to other clients.
Deposits are non-refundable. If you need to cancel, the deposit can be applied toward a future booking or service.
If the cancellation is on our end, your deposit will be fully refunded.


Payment Methods

E-transfer is the easiest method - cash is also accepted, along with Paypal and credit card online via Quickbooks invoices. We do not have a physical card reader at the studio.
Payment is due in full at the end of the session, or upon delivery of the final mix if you are only purchasing mixing or mastering services. Final deliverables will not be sent until payment is received.


In-Person Sessions

We do not accept walk-ins at this time. All in-person sessions must be booked in advance.
Sessions begin at the agreed-upon time. If you arrive late, the session will still start and end at the scheduled time and the rate will not be adjusted.
With at least 48 hours’ notice, we may be able to adjust your start time depending on availability.
To help make the most of your session, we recommend sending any files you’d like to work on (such as stems or demos) at least 24 hours in advance so we can prepare.
The studio does not operate in Pro Tools. If you would like to work from a Pro Tools session, please send stems or a demo for us to work from instead.
Mixing and mastering are offered as separate services unless time is specifically set aside for them during your session.
At the end of a recording session, you can expect to receive lightly edited and comped takes, rather than a fully finished song.


Mixing and Mastering Services

All mixing and mastering services include three additional revisions after the first mix delivery at no additional charge. Further revisions are subject to hourly rates.


Smoking and Consumption

Smoking and drug use are not permitted inside the studio. You are welcome to smoke outside.
Food is allowed at your discretion, provided it does not pose a risk to studio equipment. Non-breakable, sealable containers such as travel mugs are recommended for drinks.


Get in Touch
